title: Seed: Minimal, self-modifying agent harness
summary: Seed is a lightweight, minimal framework for building AI agents with self-modifying capabilities, allowing agents to update their own behavior or code during execution. It provides a stripped-down harness compared to larger agent frameworks like LangChain or AutoGPT, focusing on core functionality for experimentation with autonomous agent behaviors.
problem_solved: Provides a minimal, experimental framework for building self-modifying AI agents without the complexity and overhead of larger agent frameworks.
why_valuable: Enables rapid prototyping and experimentation with self-modifying agent concepts in a lightweight, understandable codebase for researchers and developers exploring autonomous AI behaviors.
